title: Golden-Retriever: Agentic RAG for Industrial Knowledge Bases
summary: This community centers on the paper 'Golden-Retriever: HighFidelity Agentic Retrieval Augmented Generation for Industrial Knowledge Base,' published in 2024. The work is authored by a collaborative team including Zhiyu An, Xianzhong Ding, Yen-Chun Fu, Cheng-Chung Chu, Yan Li, and Wan Du. It is cited within a broader survey on GraphRAG technologies as an example of advanced retrieval methods designed to enhance information accuracy and relevance in industrial settings.
key_findings: The paper 'Golden-Retriever' focuses on HighFidelity Agentic Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) specifically tailored for industrial knowledge bases.
The research team consists of six authors: Zhiyu An, Xianzhong Ding, Yen-Chun Fu, Cheng-Chung Chu, Yan Li, and Wan Du.
The work was published in 2024 and is available on arXiv under the identifier 2408.00798 in the cs.IR category.
The paper is referenced in a J. ACM survey (Vol. 37, No. 4, Article 111) that categorizes GraphRAG techniques and application scenarios.
The survey context suggests that such agentic RAG approaches address limitations of traditional RAG by leveraging relational knowledge to improve retrieval relevance and comprehensiveness.
